english.note: Use this intensifying construction before an adjective, such as 好多 for “an awful amount.”

exampleSentences.english: There was an awful amount of work today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 jau5 hou2 do1 je5 zou6

english.note: Use this construction before another adjective when the result is pleasantly or desirably A, as in 好熱 for “nice and hot.”

exampleSentences.english: The soup is nice and hot today.
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 jat6 di1 tong1 hou2 jit6
